signature: (state: poke_engine.State, duration_ms: int = 1000, iterations: int = 0, threads: int = 1) -> poke_engine.MctsResult
observation: Rust mcts converts PyState to a fresh State, obtains root options and calls perform_mcts or shared-tree search; result is converted to root statistics. The public function accepts no tree handle and returns none. No continuation/reuse API exposed by this installed wrapper. Native-internal implementation changes are outside this study.
measurement_limit: This allocation study measures fresh calls and per-world preparation. It does not measure a hypothetical continuation API or claim repeated calls reuse a tree.
